messages:
harborline_pm: Hi team, Harborline wants to onboard a bilingual (EN/ES) reranker tuned on order transcripts + customer notes. Key constraints: strip PII emails/phones, never persist raw transcripts, and HSM for signing keys. They want a go-live before next billing cycle (~3 weeks). Can we scope?

sam_cs: Thanks! Need artifact link + rough dataset counts. Also: do they require private VPC from day 1? cc @olga for privacy/eval.

harborline_pm: Link: https://s3.harborline.ai/harbor-ranker-1.1.tar.gz. Data: 60k transcripts, 10k notes. We can provide a sanitized eval set. Prefer Private VPC+HSM due to enterprise compliance.

olga: Understood. Two questions: 1) Are there any regulatory flags (GDPR export concerns)? 2) Do they need deterministic outputs for dispute resolution?

harborline_pm: GDPR applies; they need resident EU region. Deterministic outputs for any legal/external dispute flows yes.

sam_cs: OK. Ops notes: we support region pinning and HSM in Private. Latency target? Throughput?

harborline_pm: p95 < 180ms for 256 tokens, baseline throughput 120 qps. Renewal sensitivity: renewal linked to error rate and data leakage incidents. Mark as medium-high risk.

olga: Eval plan: we'll run hallucination checks, PII residual detection, and regen-stability (determinism). Need 400 labeled eval examples + 200 adversarial PII probes. Can Harborline upload samples to the shared bucket?

harborline_pm: Uploading sanitized eval bundle to https://files.harborline.ai/safe-eval by EOD. I'll also include a short acceptance criteria doc.

qa-runner: I'll own the harness. Plan: run in Redwood Optimize, metrics: MAP@10, rerank F1, PII leakage count, determinism score. Canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback if PII_leak > 0.1% or latency SLO breached.

infra-bot: Ticket CS-8012 opened: "Harborline bilingual reranker intake (Private EU + HSM)" Assignees: sam_cs, olga, infra.estimated_window: 2026-04-15..2026-04-22

sam_cs: Notes for infra: will need EU VPC peering + HSM key provisioning. For A100-backed Dedicated pools we'll reserve capacity week of go-live. Olga, legal will you need a data flow diagram?

olga: Yes please attach data flow and retention policy. Also request a sample redaction routine for review. We require proof of redaction in enablement demo.

harborline_pm: Will provide data flow + retention policy. Can the demo show live redaction + signed response proof?

qa-runner: Yes, we can include a replay test: rerank request -> redaction hook -> signed response (HSM) -> logged audit entry. We'll show PII residual scan before/after.

sam_cs: Timeline sync: once eval bundle is received, QA needs 72 hours to run baseline suite. We should schedule enablement + compliance demo next Tue. I'll send calendar.

harborline_pm: Calendar invite received. One more ask: are there extra costs for EU-hosted Dedicated + HSM?

sam_cs: Yes, there will be region premium + HSM add-on. I'll get procurement numbers and send estimate.

olga: Final: if any samples contain special category data, we pause until DPO signs off.

harborline_pm: Understood, we'll scrub and run internal PII checks before upload. Thanks all.

qa-runner: I'll post a short acceptance checklist in the ticket and link to the Redwood Optimize job after runs.

sam_cs: Closing loop: marked account health watch, renewal risk = watch. Will escalate if SLO threats appear during canary.

harborline_pm: Great, thanks!
